industry: distributed business teams and managed offshore staffing
audience: founders, operators, and functional leaders designing accountable distributed work
heroComposition: asymmetric proposition paired with a role-to-handoff SVG network map
typeCharacter: humanist operational sans with restrained serif-scale display hierarchy
paletteFamily: light operating sheets, deep teal bands, and coral reserved for conversion and focus
shapeGrammar: clipped frames, square workflow nodes, ruled sheets, thin connectors, restrained radii
imageTreatment: documentary operations photography in clipped frames with no overlays or gradients
sectionRhythm: dense ruled ledgers alternating with broad deep-teal operating bands
navigationTreatment: compact sticky white rail with inline parent attribution and ruled active state
motionSignature: low-motion horizontal review evidence stream with static reduced-motion fallback
density: 8 of 10, information-rich while maintaining readable measures
signatureElement: role-to-handoff network map connecting inputs, work, review, and exception routes
primaryTheme: light with deep teal operating bands
comparisonNote: Compared with recent corporate-modern, soft-geometric, cinematic image-first, premium monochrome, kinetic editorial, and Swiss-grid portfolio directions, this direction differs on at least eight axes: design family, hero composition, palette family, shape grammar, image treatment, section rhythm, navigation treatment, motion signature, and signature element. Its network map is operational rather than decorative, its cards are replaced by ruled ledgers, and coral is limited to conversion and focus states.
